mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or positive 20-day returns occur in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y), or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, generating wage pressures and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in HOUST (HOUST < 1000.0) does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals economic weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recession risks.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates higher corporate revenues.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic contraction.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 105.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
